atlas-sg.0116: Students of foreign universities doing a curricular internship need a Training Employment Pass: at least S$3,000 a month, three months at most, not renewable, outside quotas. A Training Work Permit allows up to six months but counts against the quota. Students at Singapore universities need no pass.
atlas-sg.0118: After a full-time degree from a Singapore public university, a one-year pass, once only, to stay and look for work. It does not allow work; with an offer you switch to an Employment or S Pass without leaving.
atlas-sg.0119: The salary must reach an age-based floor, then score at least 40 points under COMPASS on salary, qualifications, nationality diversity and local hiring. Degree claims need a verification report.
atlas-sg.0120: Mid-level roles use the S Pass, with quotas and a levy the employer pays; EU citizens cannot get ordinary work permits.
atlas-sg.0122: S$5,600 a month at 23, up to S$10,700 at 45
atlas-sg.0124: The floors rise on 1 January 2027, to S$6,000 and S$6,600.
atlas-sg.0126: Unpaid thesis research at NUS, NTU or SMU uses a non-graduating Student’s Pass; a paid research internship at a company a Training Employment Pass.
atlas-sg.0127: PhD students often hold a SINGA award covering tuition with a monthly stipend; PhD stipends are free of income tax.
atlas-sg.0131: Six months, aged 18 to 25, for students and recent graduates of universities in Australia, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, the Netherlands, New Zealand, Switzerland, the UK or the US. What counts is where the university is, not your passport: an Italian degree does not qualify.
atlas-sg.0132: Visa-free for 30 to 90 days, at the officer’s discretion, with no work. Submit the SG Arrival Card within three days before arriving.
atlas-sg.0133: Fill in the SG Arrival Card, with its health declaration, within 3 days before your flight. Students apply in the SOLAR portal (eForm 16, S$45) 2 to 3 months before classes start and travel on the in-principle approval letter.
atlas-sg.0134: Italian documents need an apostille and a sworn English translation, but no legalisation at the embassy. Check the rules before bringing controlled medicines.
atlas-sg.0135: A residential lease carries stamp duty of 0.4% of the total rent of the contract.
atlas-sg.0136: Do not start work on the in-principle approval alone: your employer must request the pass on myMOM and get the notification letter, which lets you work and travel for a month until you register biometrics for the card at the MOM Services Centre.
atlas-sg.0137: Students pay S$60 (plus S$30 visa fee if applicable) and receive a digital Student’s Pass through FileSG and Singpass.
atlas-sg.0138: The in-principle approval letter carries your temporary foreign identification number (FIN).
atlas-sg.0139: Foreigners who are not permanent residents pay nothing into the CPF pension fund; tax residents (183 days or more) pay progressive rates from 0% to 24%, with the first S$20,000 tax-free.
atlas-sg.0140: Students staying 6 months or more have a medical check (chest X-ray for tuberculosis and an HIV test), about S$55 to S$120 at approved clinics.
atlas-sg.0141: If your pass is cancelled you get a 30-day short-term visit pass that cannot be extended: without a new sponsor in that time you must leave, and overstaying over 90 days is punished with prison and caning.
atlas-sg.0142: When you stop working, your employer withholds your final pay and bonus until your taxes are cleared (form IR21).
atlas-sg.0143: Do not start work on the in-principle approval alone: wait for the notification letter.
atlas-sg.0144: When a pass is cancelled you get 30 days to leave or find a new sponsor; overstaying over 90 days means prison and caning.
atlas-sg.0145: Spouses on a Dependant’s Pass can no longer work on a letter of consent: they need their own pass.
atlas-sg.0146: When you stop working, the employer holds your last salary until the tax is cleared.
atlas-sg.0147: How COMPASS scores degrees from Bocconi, Luiss and other specialist schools not on the top-tier list.
atlas-sg.0148: Degree checks with Italian universities can take four to six weeks, not the two the agencies state.
atlas-sg.0149: ADHD and other controlled medicines need approval 10 to 14 days before the flight.
